declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 tenant + program/artifact/type/target/revision/period; exact retry matches all relationship facts/actor; one creation append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
invariant: One relationship identity immutably binds exact artifact content/revision, target revision and covered period with attributed sufficiency rationale.
boundaryRationale: Relationship components must be bound together to distinguish conflicting assertions; source artifact and target lifecycles already remain elsewhere.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused

baselineIdentityObservation: UUIDv5 tenant + program/artifact/type/target/revision/period; exact retry matches all relationship facts/actor; one creation append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Existing deterministic UUIDv5 of tenant + program/artifact/type/target/revision/period. Selected CommandId binds the exact immutable relationship and actor; the tuple algorithm is unchanged.
selectedIdentitySummary: Existing deterministic UUIDv5 of tenant + program/artifact/type/target/revision/period. Selected CommandId binds the exact immutable relationship and actor; the tuple algorithm is unchanged.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.
decides: A validation is invalidated when a new version supersedes the validated record version; the relationship stays bound to the superseded revision and is never rewritten.
